review_notes: Audited 14 modules (903 total lines across production and test). 255 lines eliminable (28.2%). All violations are Question 3 (unnecessary code). No stdlib/library replacement opportunities found (Questions 1-2). httpx is appropriate for HTTP; enum.TypedDict are the correct stdlib tools; no library would meaningfully reduce the contract/state definitions. The major finding: 11 identical stub node functions in graph.py (42 lines) that can be replaced by a 5-line factory. The contract/state test files (test_platform_contracts.py, test_sdd_contracts.py, test_sdd_state.py; 193 lines combined) tautologically test Python language guarantees — each test asserts that a TypedDict field accessor works or that a StrEnum value matches its declaration string. These provide zero behavioral coverage and would be caught by ruff's type-check mode. The Ticket dataclass in tracker.py (10 lines) is dead code: list_ready returns raw dicts, no production caller instantiates Ticket. BP_CONCURRENCY in main.py is dead config. Both __all__ blocks are ornamental. Secondary finding: decide_review and decide_verification (8 lines) can be inlined as lambdas. NOTE: TicketState.READY ('ready') is defined in the enum but excluded from TicketPipelineState.status Literal — type misalignment, not a reduction issue, but should be resolved.
